title: Check RMS Map Monitor for System Emergency-Stop Status
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor to inspect the live system emergency-stop message, fleet Total and Exception counts, and the Robot Info fields associated with a selected robot.
when_to_use: Use this diagnostic on the RMS / fleet status UI when verifying whether the live fleet is reporting a system emergency-stop state and when identifying the robot status information associated with that display.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to clear, reset, or otherwise change an emergency-stop state.
Do not use this procedure as a physical emergency-stop response or as a recovery procedure.
roles_and_responsibilities: The operator uses the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor to inspect the displayed system and robot status.
Escalation is required when the system emergency-stop message, a robot exception, or unavailable or unconfirmable RMS information is observed.
safety_notes: This procedure is read-only and does not clear or reset an emergency stop.
If the RMS Map Monitor displays a system emergency-stop state, treat the condition as requiring escalation rather than attempting a reset through this procedure.

access_required: Access to the RMS / fleet status UI.
system_preconditions: The RMS Map Monitor page is available for inspection.

visual_references.description: RMS Map Monitor frame showing the robot map, fleet Total and Exception counts, Message Panel, emergency-stop message, and Robot Info fields.

steps.title: Open the RMS Map Monitor
steps.purpose: Open the live RMS / fleet status UI page that exposes the fleet map, messages, and robot status information.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the Map Monitor page. Confirm that the robot map, Message Panel, and robot status area are displayed.
steps.expected_result: The RMS Map Monitor page is available and displays the robot map with the fleet monitoring and robot information areas.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS Map Monitor loads and the map, Message Panel, and robot status area can be inspected.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS Map Monitor is unavailable or the robot and fleet information cannot be confirmed.

actions.label: Open Map Monitor
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the Map Monitor page.

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS Map Monitor is unavailable.
The displayed robot or fleet information cannot be confirmed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR identifies the RMS Map Monitor page and shows the robot map, fleet totals, Robot Info, and Message Panel.

steps.title: Inspect fleet Total and Exception counts
steps.purpose: Determine the current fleet size and whether the RMS fleet summary reports exceptions.
steps.instruction: On the RMS Map Monitor, inspect the fleet summary and note the displayed Total and Exception counts. The captured RMS screen shows Total 34 and Exception 0; use the values currently displayed in the live RMS session rather than assuming those captured values remain current.
steps.expected_result: The current RMS fleet Total and Exception values are visible and can be used to characterize the displayed fleet state.
steps.healthy_condition: The Total and Exception fields are visible and the current Exception count does not indicate a robot exception.
steps.failure_condition: The Exception count indicates one or more exceptions, or the Total or Exception fields are unavailable or cannot be confirmed.

actions.label: Inspect fleet summary
actions.exact_action: Check the fleet summary for the displayed Total and Exception counts.

stop_or_escalate_if: The Exception count indicates a robot exception.
The Total or Exception values cannot be confirmed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows Home Robot Total 34 Exception 0.

steps.title: Check the system emergency-stop message
steps.purpose: Determine whether the live RMS Map Monitor is reporting a system emergency-stop state.
steps.instruction: Inspect the RMS Map Monitor Message Panel and message area for the exact status text "Currently in system emergency stop state."
steps.expected_result: The operator can determine whether the RMS Message Panel currently displays the system emergency-stop status.
steps.healthy_condition: The exact system emergency-stop message is not displayed in the current RMS Message Panel.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS Map Monitor displays "Currently in system emergency stop state."

actions.label: Inspect emergency-stop message
actions.exact_action: Check whether the Map Monitor displays the message "Currently in system emergency stop state."

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS Map Monitor displays "Currently in system emergency stop state."
The Message Panel or displayed status cannot be confirmed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows the RMS Map Monitor message "Currently in system emergency stop state." and identifies the map monitoring page in relation to emergency-stop triggering.

steps.title: Review the selected robot status fields
steps.purpose: Associate the displayed system or exception state with the affected robot's live RMS status details.
steps.instruction: When an affected robot entry is present in the RMS Map Monitor, select it and review the Robot Info panel. Inspect Robot ID, Type, Node Code, Path Mode, Location, Exception status, and Robot Task information. The captured screen includes Robot ID 1555125, Type P40-V2, Node Code 11001075, Path Mode IDLE, Location, Exception status, and Robot Task details; use the values currently displayed for the selected robot.
steps.expected_result: The selected robot's identifying, location, exception, path, and task fields are visible and can be associated with the RMS emergency-stop or exception display.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected robot's Robot ID, Type, Node Code, Path Mode, Location, Exception status, and Robot Task fields are available for inspection, with no unaccounted exception shown.
steps.failure_condition: The selected robot shows an exception or emergency-stop-related status, or the required Robot Info fields are unavailable or cannot be confirmed.

actions.label: Select affected robot
actions.exact_action: Select the affected robot entry, when present, and review the displayed Robot ID, Type, Node Code, Path Mode, Location, Exception status, and task information.

stop_or_escalate_if: The selected robot has an exception or emergency-stop-related status.
The Robot Info fields or associated task information cannot be confirmed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows Robot Info fields including Robot ID 1555125, Type P40-V2, Node Code 11001075, Path Mode IDLE, Location, Exception status, and Robot Task information.

success_criteria: The RMS Map Monitor loads successfully.
The current fleet Total and Exception counts are visible.
The operator determines whether the exact system emergency-stop message is displayed.
When an affected robot is present, its Robot Info fields and task information are available for escalation.
healthy_conditions: The RMS Map Monitor, fleet summary, Message Panel, and Robot Info area are available.
The current Exception count does not indicate an exception.
The Message Panel does not display "Currently in system emergency stop state."
A selected robot's identifying and status fields can be confirmed without an unaccounted exception.
failure_conditions: The RMS Map Monitor is unavailable or its displayed information cannot be confirmed.
The fleet Exception count indicates an exception.
The Message Panel displays "Currently in system emergency stop state."
A selected robot displays an exception or emergency-stop-related status.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when the RMS Map Monitor displays "Currently in system emergency stop state."
Escalate when the fleet summary or selected robot shows an exception or emergency-stop-related status.
Escalate when the RMS Map Monitor is unavailable or the robot and fleet information cannot be confirmed.
Do not attempt to clear or reset the emergency stop using this diagnostic.
